split_definitions.id: 1-3 structures, training kind distribution, no held-out pair
split_definitions.combo_ood: contains a held-out kind pair: cottage+tree, hut+tower, bridge+dune, watchtower+pond, arch+garden, multistory+granary, fortress+aqueduct, colonnade+stairs

tasks.collapse: predict the settled state after the intervention; cell accuracy / structure IoU / change F1 / cascade F1
tasks.counterfactual: rank the two interventions by change rate (only samples with rank_valid)
tasks.long_rollout: violations of check_violations() on the last predicted frame (ground truth = 0)

intervention_format: {kind, steps:[{t, actions:[{type,x,y,material,layer}]}]}; actions of step t are applied before tick t
label: fraction of mask cells that differ between the initial and final state; mask = built cells above the surface in either state plus any changed cell
